label: Recurrent actor-market + cyclic path matrix density - H15 - one shared block - joint actor/market W256 - A128/C256/M128 - K1=K2=8 - P=R=8/B=16 - Q16/D64/O32 - DQ128/DO256 compression - 256k clean - batch 768

architecture.marketProcess: one actor-market cell weight-shared across all 15 horizons; all actor and market slots are batched within each transform
architecture.pathConditioning: after every actor-market transition, flatten(actors) and flatten(markets) are independently compressed to W, fused by a shared GNGLU(2W,W), and receive a learned absolute-horizon embedding
architecture.conditionalReturns: T_s=row-softmax(P_s R_s/sqrt(Q)); J_s=q_s[:,None] times T_s; p_s=sum_D(J_s)
architecture.pathTransition: P_s and J_s are independently compressed to 128 and 256 values; P_s+1=shared-GNGLU(concat(compress(P_s),W_s,compress(J_s),point-state_s))
architecture.outputPoints: ordered W-conditioned unit-interval knots initialized from the fixed global 32-knot grid
architecture.actorCertainty: actor-specific learned minimum top-action probability in [1/P,0.95] applied to every actor-market P-way cosine distribution

density.targetFilter: each start and every path target are exact-nonzero active returns
density.trainingLoss: mean dynamic marginal return-density NLL across 15 recurrent steps
